title: Top 10 Daily Income Business Without Investment From Home in India
summary: Top 10 daily income business ideas without investment from home in India: zero-cost businesses that pay daily or per action, with realistic earning ranges.
body_markdown:
A **daily income business without investment** means two promises: you never put money in, and money can come out often, not once a month. That rules out anything needing stock, rent, or fees, and it favours work where each small action pays: an approved application, a delivered order, an answered question, a completed gig.


These 10 businesses run from home in India with no money down; each is a true[zero investment business](https://gromo.in/blog/zero-investment-business/) , and each one can generate daily income once it is warmed up. For every idea you get the payment frequency, realistic daily earning, and who it suits, in the same simple format. One rule first: if any opportunity asks for a joining fee or deposit, it is not a business, it is a trap.

## Commission Businesses: Highest Daily Earnings


### 1. Sell Financial Products with GroMo


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Per approved application, transfers as you earn


**Daily earning potential** Rs 300-2,000+ on a good day


**Best for** Anyone with a phone and a trusted network


**How it works:** GroMo is the strongest daily income business without investment because every day brings new chances to earn: help one person open a savings account today, another get a credit card tomorrow. Commissions are added as applications get approved, and payouts transfer to your bank quickly. A single approved credit card can pay up to Rs 2,000, and the app shows the payout on every product before you share it. Still doubtful? Read[is GroMo real or fake](https://gromo.in/blog/is-gromo-real-or-fake/) . Free training in the GroMo Academy means you can start today, and[credit card agent registration](https://gromo.in/blog/credit-card-agent-registration/) takes minutes with no documents; registration takes minutes with no documents.


### 2. Online Reselling with Meesho and Shopsy


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Per delivered order


**Daily earning potential** Rs 100-1,500 per day


**Best for** Homemakers and anyone with active WhatsApp groups


**How it works:** Share catalogue products with your margin added; the platform handles delivery and payment. Orders can come every day once your circle knows you sell, and festive seasons multiply them. Zero stock means zero risk: you never spend money, you only add margin.


### 4. Deal Sharing with EarnKaro


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Per sale through your links


**Daily earning potential** Rs 100-1,000 per day


**Best for** People active in WhatsApp and Telegram deal groups


**How it works:** Convert any product link into your profit link and share deals daily. Every purchase through your link earns commission. Consistent deal-sharers build daily trickles that add up to Rs 3,000-15,000 a month, and there is no KYC or fee to start.


## Skill Businesses: Paid for What You Know


### 3. Doubt-Solving and Hourly Tutoring


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Per answer or per class


**Daily earning potential** Rs 200-1,500 per day


**Best for** Anyone strong in maths, science, English, or coding


**How it works:** Chegg-style platforms pay per question you answer, any day you log in. Add one or two evening tuition batches and you have daily skill income with zero investment. Earnings track your hours directly, which makes this the most predictable daily earner on the list.


### 6. Micro-Freelancing Gigs


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Per delivered gig


**Daily earning potential** Rs 300-2,500 per day


**Best for** Writers, designers, editors, translators


**How it works:** Small fixed gigs on Fiverr, Upwork, and Internshala: a logo, a blog post, a reel edit, a translation. Deliver one or two small projects a day and money lands with each completion. Your rate roughly doubles every ten good reviews, so daily income grows every month.


### 7. AI Data Tasks


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Per task batch


**Daily earning potential** Rs 150-800 per day


**Best for** Careful, detail-focused workers


**How it works:** Platforms pay for labelling images, rating chatbot answers, and checking translations, claimed task by task, any day you want. Indian language tasks pay extra. Accuracy unlocks better queues, which raises your daily rate over time.


## Digital and Home Businesses


### 8. Sell Digital Products


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Per sale, any day


**Daily earning potential** Rs 100-2,000 per day once listed


**Best for** Anyone with knowledge worth packaging


**How it works:** Study notes, templates, recipe collections, and mini-guides sell around the clock once listed. The work is front-loaded: create once, then sales arrive on random days, including while you sleep. Pair it with WhatsApp and Telegram distribution for daily visibility.


### 9. Pre-Order Home Food


**Investment** Rs 0 (customers pay in advance)


**How you get paid** Daily, on delivery


**Daily earning potential** Rs 300-2,000 per day


**Best for** Good cooks with an office or PG crowd nearby


**How it works:** The zero investment trick is the pre-order model: take confirmed orders and advance payment today, cook tomorrow. No stock, no waste, no capital. Start with one item for one office or PG, and let taste plus punctuality grow the order list daily.


## Micro Earners: Small but Truly Daily


### 5. Task and Survey Apps with Daily UPI Payouts


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Daily or instant to UPI


**Daily earning potential** Rs 50-300 per day


**Best for** Students and anyone with spare minutes


**How it works:** Task apps and survey panels pay small amounts that clear to UPI daily or within days. This is true daily income, just modest: pocket money in dead time. Use it as your starter while a bigger method from this list grows.


### 10. Refer and Earn Stack


**Investment** Rs 0


**How you get paid** Per successful referral


**Daily earning potential** Rs 100-1,000 per day in active weeks


**Best for** People whose friends keep asking which app to use


**How it works:** Stack UPI app referrals for quick small rewards with bigger product referrals for real money (see the[high paying refer and earn apps](https://gromo.in/blog/high-paying-refer-and-earn-apps/) ). Rewards land as friends complete actions, which in an active week means something credits almost daily. Recommend only what you use; trust is the whole engine.


## How to Build Daily Income in 30 Days


1. Week 1: pick one main business from the commission or skill groups and one micro earner for instant proof.
2. Week 2: serve your first 5 customers or complete your first 10 tasks; note what paid best per hour.
3. Week 3: fix a daily routine: one hour of outreach or work at the same time every day.
4. Week 4: ask every happy customer for one referral and repeat what worked; drop what did not.


The honest truth about daily income: the first week pays little, the fourth week pays daily. Every business here rewards showing up every day more than working hard on one day. Pick the one that matches what you have, and start today. Want more options with small budgets? See our full list of[business ideas from home](https://gromo.in/blog/business-ideas-from-home-in-india/) .


## FAQ: Daily Income Business Without Investment


**Which is the best business for daily income without investment?**


GroMo gives the best mix of zero investment and high per-day earning: each approved financial product pays Rs 300-2,000+, and busy weeks bring approvals almost daily. For predictable daily amounts, doubt-solving and tutoring pay for every hour worked, and task apps pay small amounts to UPI truly daily. Most successful people run one big earner plus one micro earner together.


**Can I really earn daily income online without investment?**


Yes, if you match expectations to the method. Task and survey apps pay small amounts daily from day one. Gig work, reselling, and doubt-solving pay per completed unit, which becomes near-daily within weeks of consistent effort. Commission businesses like GroMo pay per approval, so daily income arrives once your pipeline of customers is steady, usually by week 3-4.


**Which daily income business is best for housewives and students?**


Housewives do best with reselling, pre-order home food, and GroMo referrals in their society network. Students do best with doubt-solving, task apps, and GroMo on campus. All of these pause freely during exams or family time and restart without losing anything.


**How much can I earn daily from these businesses?**


Realistic day ranges once warmed up: Rs 50-300 from task apps, Rs 100-1,500 from reselling and deal sharing, Rs 200-2,500 from skill work like tutoring and gigs, and Rs 300-2,000+ from GroMo on approval days. Monthly totals of Rs 10,000-40,000 are common for people who work their method one focused hour daily.


**What should I avoid in daily income businesses?**


Three traps: anything asking a joining fee or deposit (a real business never charges you to earn), daily payment schemes that pay from new members' money (that is a chain scheme, not income), and spreading across five methods at once. One main earner, one micro earner, and daily consistency beat everything.
